context.p: This task walks you through making your first audio recording in . You will need a microphone connected to your computer. If you are unfamiliar with audio terminology, read first.

note.p: For best results, record in a quiet room and position your microphone 6-12 inches from your mouth.

info.p: If this is your first time, will open with an empty project window showing a gray waveform area.

step.cmd: Select your microphone from the recording device dropdown in the Device Toolbar.

info.p: The Device Toolbar is near the top of the window. The recording device dropdown has a microphone icon next to it.

step.cmd: Click the Record button to start recording.

info.p: You will see a blue waveform appear as captures audio from your microphone.

note.p: If you see a flat line instead of a waveform, your microphone may not be selected correctly. Click Stop and check your recording device setting.

step.cmd: Speak into your microphone or play the audio you want to capture.
Click the Stop button when you are finished recording.
Click the Play button to listen to your recording.

result.p: You now have a recorded audio track in your project. The waveform display shows the shape of your recorded audio. Louder sounds appear as taller waves.
